name: Kindred Dominance
clause: Choose a creature type. Destroy all creatures that aren't of the chosen type.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'choose-type'; what: 'creature-type' | 'color' | 'card-type'; who?: ScopeWho }   AND   Filter.notChosenType?: boolean
needs.semantics: A one-shot 'Choose a creature type.' an instant or sorcery can perform, recording the choice on the resolving item so later effects of the same item read it through Filter.chosenType / notChosenType. Today only the as-enters replacement {kind:'choose', what:'creature-type'} exists, and a non-permanent never reaches it.
needs.clause: Choose a creature type. Destroy all creatures that aren't of the chosen type.

needs.proposedSignature: Filter.notChosenType?: boolean — in matchesFilter(s, o, f, source): `if (f?.notChosenType && source?.chosen?.creatureType && subtypes(o).includes(source.chosen.creatureType)) return false;` (the exact mirror of the existing `chosenType` clause at characteristics.ts:231)
needs.semantics: "…that aren't of the chosen type": the exact negation of the chosen creature type recorded on the source by the layers family's `choose-type` effect. Note that a card with no choice recorded yet must match nothing for `chosenType` and everything for `notChosenType`, so the two are not simply `!`-of each other in the no-choice case. With this one boolean, Kindred Dominance is `[{op:'choose-type',what:'creature-type'},{op:'destroy',target:'all-creatures',filter:{notChosenType:true}}]`.
needs.clause: Destroy all creatures that aren't of the chosen type.
